verified_title: Telecom World Models: Unifying Digital Twins, Foundation Models, and Predictive Planning for 6G
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2604.06882: Telecom World Models: Unifying Digital Twins, Foundation Models, and Predictive Planning for 6G
method_summary: A telecom world-model framework explicitly includes topology/interference state, queues, protocol variables, latency and packet loss, handover interruption, policy counterfactuals, uncertainty, multi-timescale predictive planning, safety constraints, shadow deployment and rollback. It distinguishes observational policy bias from intervention effects.
evidence_and_limits: Conceptual framework with a network-slicing proof of concept. Many proposed capabilities are not validated implementations of the exact warehouse setting. It nevertheless preempts novelty based solely on listing these components.
